name: Scrying
description:
Casting time: 10 minutes. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

You can see and hear a particular creature you choose, regardless of their and your location. Roll Awareness vs Awareness against the creature. If you have never seen the creature, your roll is ill-favored. If you have seen and spoken to the creature, your roll is favored. The creature senses your presence in this moment (though not your identity), and may choose to lose the check voluntarily if it wants to be observed.

On a win, the spell creates an invisible, magical sensor within short range of the creature. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the creature, remaining within short range of it. The sensor has the same field of vision as you and is always oriented toward the creature. A creature that can see invisible objects sees the sensor as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.

On a loss, no effect, and you can’t use this spell against the same creature again for 1 day.

Instead of targeting a creature, you can choose a location you have seen before as the target of this spell. When you do, the sensor appears at that location and doesn’t move.

Describe how you perceive magically.
successes:
✨: On a win, the sensor can see in all directions.

🌞: On a win, you may spend an action to have the sensor stop following the creature. For the next minute, you may move the sensor up to your Speed in any direction. At the end of the minute, the spell ends. On a loss, you know the direction and distance of the creature from you.
